title: Detector facts
description:
What the runner's detectors found in the tree of GITHUB_SHA: a detector id and a line locator with the hash of those lines. Never text. Rules JSON Schema cannot state: line_end >= line_start. Line-range hash: the lines line_start..line_end (1-based, inclusive) of the file at GITHUB_SHA, each without its terminator (
 or 
), joined with 
, no trailing 
, hashed as UTF-8 with SHA-256, lowercase hex.

version.description: Version of the reader contract. A new version is a new contract: every party moves together.

detector_id.description: Closed catalogue of detectors (plan R4 section 1, layer D, plus the hints the plan names). The step and the workflow of seetrex-ai/compliance-action itself are never a fact. security_contact is a reporting contact a third party can reach: an e-mail address, the Contact: of .well-known/security.txt (RFC 9116), or a URL outside the pushing repository; the .../security/advisories/new form of the pushing repository itself is never a security_contact fact, because the experiment treats every repository as private and a third party cannot open that form in a private repository.

repo_path.description: Repository-relative path with forward slashes: no leading slash, no empty, '.' or '..' segment.

sha256.description: Lowercase hex SHA-256. Validators in Python must use re.fullmatch (or \Z): with re.match or re.search, $ also accepts a trailing newline.
